sentences.text: On the Garnet-Retail test split, Thimble's long-tail Recall@20 of 0.091 exceeds both Cobble-GNN's 0.072 and Cobble-GNN + debiased sampling's 0.085, corresponding to relative gains of 26.4% and 7.1%, respectively.

The 18.1% relative improvement in long-tail Recall@20 from Cobble-GNN + debiased sampling (0.085 vs 0.072) is consistent with the roughly 20% relative gains reported by Sorensen-Nakata et al. (2022) for popularity-debiased negative sampling, though that prior work used different datasets.
Thimble's overall Recall@20 (0.219) is only slightly higher than Cobble-GNN's (0.214) and Cobble-GNN + debiased sampling's (0.212), with relative differences of at most 2.3%.
No statistical tests were reported, so these differences, while directionally consistent with the expected benefits of debiased sampling, should be interpreted cautiously on this single dataset.
